gates.transport: Every rendered K8 has 36 submitted samples: depth/final/AC/EB every frame, material/albedo at both ends. Every presented capture has eight consecutive frames. Missing/duplicate/nonfinite data is INVALID.
gates.registration: Reuse edge_flicker registration_structure/registered_run/shifted_mask. Exclude subtitle region for Dialogue3. Reject camera cuts and animation-confounded comparisons; never warp beauty frames.
gates.masks: Freeze masks from both OFF repeats: class-5 support against baseline depth discontinuities for hair-over-DoF, brightest 1 percent of baseline character contours, eroded depth-stable class-3 face control, far depth-stable background excluding character silhouettes. No candidate-derived mask or retuned threshold.
gates.residual: Use edge_flicker.energy midpoint residual by parity, independently on rendered and presented sequences. Both ON repeats must improve beyond the measured OFF-repeat spread; historical late-RR values are targets, not new reference measurements.
gates.components: Decode rr_post_ac as C.rgb/A.a, rr_post_eb as bloom.rgb/exposure.a, Vulkan formats 97 (OFF) or 109 (ON). Report component residuals independently; exposure must stay fresh.
gates.energy: Energy traces retain rrpost slots 1 (effective AC), 2 (linear RR Z), 6 (effective EB), 384-wide nearest float32 RGBA *_p.f32 sidecars. Join trace rrpost image references to dumps.json. For ON, sample AC/EB at uv+jitter/renderSize from the energy jitter log; OFF samples at uv. Reconstruct the same chain_value (including rr_post_quantise R11 truncations) from Z, AC and EB. Compare fixed far-background float mean across both OFF/ON repeats; report full-image dumps.json float means as an independent check. PNG/PQ means and isolated bloom means cannot pass the energy gate.
gates.timing: Only timing-* phases, separate from bursts/float traces. No build, compile or GPU tool may overlap cost windows. Missing active=1 temporal timing in either ON window is INVALID.
gates.qualification: No quality pass until both scenes and both ON windows pass. Keep key off in presets.

capture.disk_bound_note: Includes 70 MB logs/summaries; <2 GiB. Float previews and small PNGs reserved inside summary allowance. No full raw trace dumps. Analyze/delete raw per scene; keep reports.
